what: digit label of each numeral bitmap of the census (digit-census-r1.json), by the bitmap's shape
basis: each bitmap was printed as ASCII and its example crop (census example: sitting, frame sha256, x, y) was looked at; every digit 0-9 has one bitmap, drawn the same in white and in cyan. Not labelled, so never matched (the reader marks a country holding one unread): the 16x17 ring of a country label (549f54...), a '1' clipped by a grey overlay on its right edge (8d7cfd..., 195 blobs of sitting 20261008T184505Z, whose right neighbour cannot be seen), and three one-off damaged glyphs (714d4c..., c84b02..., 966f15...)
